review_candidates.title: Senior Windows Operations Engineer
review_candidates.company: Ministry of Education, Culture and Science
review_candidates.description: Dit ga je doen Bij ODC-Noord werk je aan serveromgevingen waar overheidsorganisaties iedere dag op moeten kunnen vertrouwen. Samen met je collega’s beheer je ruim 50 VMaaS-omgevingen voor onze afnemers en voor ODC-Noord zelf. Dat vraagt om technische diepgang, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om ook bij complexe verstoringen overzicht te houden. Als Windows Operations Engineer zorg jij dat deze omgevingen stabiel, veilig en beschikbaar blijven en dat de dienstverlening stap voor stap slimmer en beter beheerbaar wordt. In deze senior rol pak je zelfstandig de complexere technische vraagstukken op. Je overziet de impact en risico’s van wijzigingen en verstoringen, weegt oplossingsrichtingen af en bent binnen het team een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe Windows-vraagstukken. Je komt terecht in het Windows Operations team: een team van 11 collega’s waar collegialiteit en samenwerking belangrijk zijn. Twee dagen per week werk je samen op kantoor. Dat zijn de momenten waarop jullie intensief samenwerken aan complexe vraagstukken, sprint events houden en kennis met elkaar delen. Samen met de RHEL Operations en Netwerk Operations teams beheer en onderhoud je de VMaaS-omgevingen van onze afnemers. Je werkzaamheden bestaan deels uit sprintwerk en deels uit dagelijkse beheerwerkzaamheden vanuit de lijn. In de sprints werk je aan verbeteringen en vernieuwingen van de dienstverlening, bijvoorbeeld door processen slimmer in te richten, beheerwerk te vereenvoudigen of technische verbeteringen door te voeren in de Windows-omgevingen. Vanuit je senior rol signaleer je daarbij zelf waar structurele verbetering nodig is en help je deze verbeteringen van analyse naar uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast pak je dagelijkse beheerwerkzaamheden op. Je lost complexe incidenten op, handelt wijzigingen af en voert controles uit naar aanleiding van monitoringssignalen. Wanneer er iets speelt in een omgeving, analyseer je wat er gebeurt en kijk je verder dan de afzonderlijke melding of server. Je brengt technische afhankelijkheden en de impact op de omgeving in kaart, weegt mogelijke oplossingen en risico’s af en bepaalt binnen je vakgebied welke aanpak nodig is. Wanneer een verstoring meerdere onderdelen van de infrastructuur raakt, stem je af met collega’s en andere technische teams en houd je vanuit Windows Operations overzicht over de samenhang. Daarbij heb je regelmatig rechtstreeks contact met afnemers, bijvoorbeeld om een complexe wijziging af te stemmen of hen mee te nemen in de voortgang, technische keuzes en gevolgen van een incident. Ook binnen het team neem je vanuit je ervaring een senior rol. Je bent een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt bij complexe Windows-vraagstukken, helpt collega’s bij analyses wanneer een standaardaanpak niet voldoende is en deelt actief je kennis en ervaring. Ook consignatie hoort bij deze functie. Ongeveer één week per drie maanden ben je 24/7 bereikbaar voor ernstige incidenten. Op die momenten telt jouw ervaring: je houdt overzicht, beoordeelt de impact, stelt prioriteiten en bepaalt welke acties nodig zijn. Samen met collega’s zorg je dat de dienstverlening zo snel en zorgvuldig mogelijk wordt hersteld. Dit krijg je Schaal 11 €4.132 - €6.275 (bruto) Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd 32 - 36 uur Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur. Dit bieden we nog meer Naast het salaris ontvang je een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,50% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaalvriendelijke doelen. Zo mag je maximaal € 2.000,00 IKB-budget per jaar gebruiken voor het fiscaalvriendelijk aflossen van je persoonlijke studieschuld bij DUO. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je ov-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer. Ook bieden we je de mogelijkheid om de voor jou belangrijke feestdagen te vieren zonder dat je daar een vrije dag voor hoeft op te nemen. Hemelvaartsdag en/of 2e pinksterdag kun je bijvoorbeeld inruilen voor een andere feestdag. Hierover maak je afspraken met je leidinggevende. Dit vragen wij Met jouw ruime ervaring in Windows-serveromgevingen weet je wat er nodig is om complexe infrastructuur stabiel, veilig en betrouwbaar te houden. Je bent gewend om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, zelfstandig technische afwegingen te maken en bij complexe incidenten rustig te blijven nadenken. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar het oplossen van een probleem, maar ook naar de oorzaak en wat nodig is om herhaling te voorkomen. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring met het beheren en troubleshooten van Windows-serveromgevingen, waarvan ervaring binnen complexe of bedrijfskritische infrastructuur. Je hebt gedegen kennis van Windows-gebaseerde VMaaS-omgevingen en kunt technische afhankelijkheden binnen een omgeving doorgronden. Je hebt ervaring met complexe incidenten en wijzigingen, waarbij je impact bepaalt, oplossingsrichtingen afweegt en technische risico’s inzichtelijk maakt. Je hebt ervaring met monitoring en weet terugkerende verstoringen en beheerproblemen te vertalen naar structurele technische verbeteringen. Je hebt ervaring met sprintmatig werken aan verbeteringen en vernieuwingen en met samenwerken met andere technische disciplines. Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, door opleiding of aantoonbare ervaring in een vergelijkbare technische functie. Hier kom je te werken Meer over ODC-Noord ODC-Noord is de cloud service provider van en voor de Rijksoverheid en valt onder de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs. Vanuit Groningen leveren ongeveer 170 collega’s infrastructuur- en platformdiensten aan ministeries en overheidsorganisaties. De dienstverlening varieert van housing en hosting tot IaaS- en PaaS-oplossingen voor zo’n 45 afnemers binnen elf ministeries. De organisatie combineert technische diepgang met een sterke focus op samenwerking en continuïteit. Hoewel technologie de basis vormt, draait het in de praktijk om de kwaliteit van de mensen. Teams zijn betrokken, kennen elkaar goed en werken samen aan betrouwbare en veilige digitale dienstverlening. Over Shared Service Organisatie Noord (SSO-Noord) SSO-Noord bundelt rijksbrede dienstverlening op het gebied van inkoop, IT en datacenters. Onder SSO-Noord vallen ODC-Noord (Overheidsdatacenter Noord) en IUC-Noord (Inkoop Uitvoeringscentrum Noord). Vanuit deze onderdelen ondersteunen we ruim veertig rijksorganisaties bij hun bedrijfsvoering. SSO-Noord is onderdeel van DUO (Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs). We zorgen ervoor dat systemen van de overheid blijven draaien, data veilig wordt opgeslagen en rijksorganisaties professioneel en verantwoord inkopen. Werken bij SSO-Noord betekent werken in een organisatie waar veel kennis samenkomt en waar vakmanschap centraal staat. Je werkt met collega’s die trots zijn op hun vak, je krijgt ruimte om je te ontwikkelen en draagt bij aan dienstverlening waar dagelijks veel rijksorganisaties op vertrouwen. Een plek waar je werk ertoe doet en waar je graag wilt werken. Bijzonderheden We vinden gelijke kansen belangrijk. Daarom vragen we geen motivatiebrief. Alle kandidaten beantwoorden dezelfde vragen in het sollicitatieformulier. Zo beoordelen we iedereen op een eerlijke en vergelijkbare manier, op basis van CV en antwoorden. We ontvangen graag je reactie uiterlijk op 13 november 2026. De gesprekken plannen we graag in overleg in. Na de sluitingsdatum zijn de vacaturetekst en de gegevens van de contactpersonen online niet meer zichtbaar. Om te voorkomen dat je deze moet opvragen, vragen wij je de vacaturetekst te downloaden en te bewaren. Controleer regelmatig je ongewenste/spam e-mailmap. Het kan voorkomen dat mailwisseling vanuit DUO in deze map(pen) terechtkomt. Ben je een intermediair? Wij werven zelf of met onze vaste partners via het Rijksinkoopstelsel. Acquisitie is niet gewenst. Over de functiegroep Senior Medewerker Iv Door het Functiegebouw Rijk worden medewerkers en leidinggevenden geholpen bij het maken van resultaat- en ontwikkelafspraken in functioneringsgesprekken en krijgt men inzicht in de loopbaanmogelijkheden binnen de Rijksoverheid. review_candidates.title: Senior Program Manager, AFGHS-IMA (Ethiopia)
review_candidates.description: The Organization IMA-World Health which is part of Corus International, has been present in Ethiopia since October 2025. Corus International is the parent of a family of world-class organizations working to deliver the holistic, lasting solutions needed to end extreme poverty once and for all. We are a global leader in international development, with 150 years of combined experience across our brands. Our nonprofit and for-profit subsidiaries include IMA World Health and its fundraising brand Corus World Health, Lutheran World Relief, CGA Technologies, Ground Up Investing, and Farmers Market Brands. In Vietnam, Corus operates under Lutheran World Relief. Our more than 400 employees around the globe are experts in their fields and dedicated to helping the world's most vulnerable people break the cycle of poverty and lead healthy lives. At Corus we believe that good only grows stronger and we reflect that belief in our workplace culture. We value every employee's specialized area of expertise and nurture professional growth. We promote an engaging and supportive work environment, where employees feel enabled and driven to innovate, learn and collaborate. And because our subsidiaries often function as partners, our employees have the opportunity to work across our enterprise family. Project Overview America First Global Health Strategy (AFGHA-IMA) project operates across 11 regions and 100 woredas/districts in Ethiopia and is implemented through a consortium of international and local partners. It aims to strengthen health system resilience and global health security through four integrated objectives: improving access to efficient, quality health services at facility and community levels; strengthening health information systems, supply chains, laboratory networks, and data use; enhancing national and local capacity for early outbreak detection and timely response; and enabling a sustainable transition to government ownership. The project emphasizes country-led implementation, local partnerships, government capacity strengthening, and coordinated efforts to sustain health outcomes beyond donor support.IM Job Brief The Senior Program Manager (SPM) functions as a highly visible individual contributor and applies their expertise in managing the project cycle for the Department of State (Dos)-funded America First Global Health Strategy-IMA (AFGHS-IMA) project in Ethiopia. The SPM provides programmatic guidance and operational management to ensure program goals, deliverables, and donor requirements are achieved. The SPM collaborates closely with colleagues across AFGHS-IMA Ethiopia and with the Headquarters (HQ) Team to ensure project success. Working closely with the DCOP for AFGHS-IMA Ethiopia, other members of the AFGHS-IMA Ethiopia team, and sub-awardees, and in partnership with the HQ Grants and Compliance team, Finance, AFGHS-IMA's Senior Technical Director, the MERL team, the HQ SPM, and the Director of Country Programs, the AFGHS-IMA Ethiopia SPM maintains a comprehensive understanding of country context, program design, implementation progress, and risk and results. S/he serves as a key resource for programmatic information, analysis, and decision support. The AFGHS-IMA Ethiopia project aims to sustain and transition lifesaving maternal, newborn, and child health, HIV, tuberculosis, malaria, nutrition, and global health security programming in Ethiopia. The overarching goal of the program is to support partner countries across diverse geographic and epidemiological contexts in developing and implementing high-impact, integrated health programs that strengthen health system resilience, advance health security, and improve health outcomes of target populations. Responsibilities Program Management Establish and manage project cycle best practices, ensuring compliance with AFGHS-IMA's Project Management Policies and Procedures and related sub-award, procurement, and finance and administration requirements. Manage project start-up processes by coordinating handover across Program Strategy, and Grants and Contracts; convening key stakeholders; and supporting project staff recruitment, including job description development and interviews, as needed. Monitor implementation of the Ethiopia program especially those implemented by sub awardees by tracking progress against targets and deliverables, identifying and addressing risks and challenges, and ensuring that technical and financial reporting requirements are met. Serve as the primary point of contact for prime and sub-award contracts and grant agreements, unless otherwise assigned. Apply expert knowledge of donor rules and regulations to ensure compliance throughout project start up, implementation, and close-out activities, including procurement, budget modifications, and award amendments. Support new award/project development, approval, implementation, and close-out deadlines and flow process in accordance with AFGHS-IMA's Project Management Policies and Procedures and relevant donor requirements. Collaborate with country staff and AFGHS-IMA's Headquarter Finance and Grants and Compliance teams to oversee grant funds and sub-awards, contract, and financial performance. Review budget variances, financial reports, and project spending; monitor spending plans, and work with project teams to ensure effective resource utilization, compliance, and timely corrective action, as needed. Liaise with AFGHS-IMA's HQ Grants and Compliance team and the Senior Grants and Finance Manager in Ethiopia to provide information or carry out follow-up actions related to sub-recipient management (contracting, reporting, and monitoring). Monitor implementation of the country level programs across districts implemented by sub-awardees under his support, backstopping and participating in regular work planning, reviewing progress toward project targets and deliverables, monitoring expenses vs. budgets, identifying issues that need to be addressed, and implementing adjustments needed. Synthesize and share biweekly, monthly and Quarterly reports and share with AFGHS_IMA Ethiopia Data Management, Documentation, and Reporting Manage project communications with AFGHS-IMA through implementation for coordination and reporting purposes. Manage the Ethiopia team and all sub-awardees to prepare high-quality, timely technical and programmatic reports, including bi-weekly reports, quarterly and semiannual reports, newsletters, websites and press releases, for internal audiences as well as donors and Corus constituents. Ensure data integrity and completeness by maintaining project documentation in electronic databases, including SharePoint. Supervisory This position has no direct reports. Education & Experience Master's with at least seven years' experience managing and implementing international development programs. or equivalent combination of education and experience; Experience working with colleagues in a multicultural, multi-linguistic environment. Experience in Managing Implementing Partners and Field-Level Operations in Conflict-Affected and Fragile Settings in Ethiopia Experience supporting health programs, including global maternal, child, and newborn health, vaccination, Nutrition and/or WASH programs, in developing and/or fragile contexts preferred. Experience working with US-based and international partners (NGO/FBO/CBOs, universities and other technical institutions). Experience successfully managing diverse groups of partners with varying capacities and experience. Experience living and/or working in developing countries preferred. Experience managing large-scale, multi-country programs a plus. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Strong working knowledge of USG (preferably DoS) and other international donor funding mechanisms (including grants, contracts, and cooperative agreements) required. Strong knowledge of international development, including humanitarian standards and best practices in health. Demonstrated ability to manage the coordination of/collaborate on program implementation across multiple teams (between departments, between Headquarters and country offices, etc.). Experience managing contracts and sub-grants, particularly those funded by the U.S. Government/DoS, preferred. Excellent communication and influencing skills to communicate effectively and credibly in English, both verbally and in writing. Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical, managerial, or operational problems in a timely and successful manner. Critical thinker with a can-do approach to problem solving and demonstrated effective interpersonal skills. Ability to meet short deadlines with quality deliverables. Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast-paced environments and work with multinational staff. Demonstrated versatility and integrity as well as leadership, mentorship, management, organizational, and decision-making skills. Proficiency in Office 365 applications including Word, Excel, SharePoint, and PowerPoint. Experience with Salesforce a plus. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Ability to influence teams where you might have responsibility but not ultimate authority. Ability to communicate tactfully and develop positive relationships across teams within the project as well as with external groups (donors, partners). Physical And Mental Requirements The physical requirements that may be needed to execute responsibilities may include bending, standing, and walking, etc. The mental requirements that are essential to satisfactorily executing the responsibilities outlined in this job description include, but are not limited to: learning new tasks, comprehending, and retaining information, completing tasks independently, effectively communicating verbally and in writing, demonstrating proficiency in using computer software to perform assigned tasks. Other Duties This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities for the position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. All positions are required to perform any additional tasks assigned by the supervisor. Global positions that are bound by contracts will not be changed without notice and approval. Working Conditions, Travel And Environment Corus has a hybrid work policy, allowing work to be done remotely; two days per week (Tuesday and Wednesday) in the office are required. The employee must be available to work outside normal office hours or weekends as required. This position must be able to travel as required for standard domestic and international business purposes. While performing the duties of this job in different locations, the employee may be exposed to precarious settings under high-security risks and/or very basic living conditions and outside weather conditions, as well as to infectious diseases. If applicable, must have authorization to work in the country of assignment. As a member of the Corus Family, each employee is expected to: Foster a work environment where everyone feels valued and included. Support employees' evaluation and promotion processes based on skills and performance. Promote a safe, secure, and respectful environment for all members of Corus family, stakeholders in general, and particularly for the communities we serve. Follow Corus Code of Conduct helping to prevent any type of abuse including workplace harassment, sexual abuse and exploitation, and trafficking in persons. Adhere to the Organizational Core Values.

review_candidates.title: Operations Analyst – Workflow & People Operations
review_candidates.description: About Fiscal 12 Fiscal 12 is a strategic accounting and finance partner to growing manufacturing businesses in the United States. We help our clients strengthen financial operations, improve visibility into profitability and cash flow, and make better business decisions. Our team works across multiple client engagements, delivering accounting, financial reporting, financial planning, and advisory services. Behind this work is a growing team of professionals, workflows, systems, and processes that must operate effectively together. We are looking for someone who can help keep those moving parts organized, connected, and running smoothly. The role We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and analytical Operations Analyst – Workflow & People Operations to support the effective delivery of our client engagements and internal operations. This role sits at the intersection of workflow management, team coordination, people operations, and process improvement. You will help maintain visibility into work across multiple client portfolios, monitor deadlines and commitments, identify operational bottlenecks, and coordinate follow-through on outstanding actions. You will also support employee onboarding, performance management processes, learning and development activities, and other people-related initiatives. This is not simply a task-tracking or administrative support role. We are looking for someone who can recognize when something is not working, ask the right questions, coordinate the appropriate response, and follow through until the issue is resolved. You will work closely with Client Leads and leadership to ensure the team has the structure, information, and support needed to deliver consistently. Key Responsibilities Workflow Management & Client Delivery Coordination Monitor workflows, deadlines, and deliverables across multiple client portfolios. Coordinate daily workflow and communication triage to ensure incoming requests are appropriately assigned and acknowledged. Track outstanding commitments and follow up with responsible team members to support timely completion. Identify overdue tasks, stalled workflows, competing priorities, and potential delivery risks. Work with Client Leads to understand operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions. Maintain visibility into upcoming deadlines and ensure potential issues are escalated early. Support consistent use of workflow management systems and established operating procedures. Operational Reporting & Performance Visibility Prepare weekly operational reports highlighting workflow exceptions, delivery risks, team capacity concerns, and outstanding actions. Identify recurring patterns in missed deadlines, delayed responses, or incomplete workflows. Track operational performance indicators and support improvements in team productivity and service delivery. Provide leadership with concise, actionable updates rather than simply reporting completed activities. Maintain action trackers and follow through on agreed improvement initiatives. People Operations & Employee Development Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including documentation, schedules, and collaboration with IT and relevant team members. Maintain employee records, onboarding checklists, and people operations trackers. Coordinate performance review schedules, probation evaluations, and development plan follow-ups. Support the planning and administration of internal learning and development activities. Monitor completion of assigned training and development actions. Help ensure people-related processes are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Identify inefficiencies, recurring workflow issues, and opportunities to simplify internal processes. Document and maintain standard operating procedures, workflows, and internal process guidelines. Recommend practical improvements to team coordination, task management, and operational reporting. Support the implementation of approved process changes and monitor their effectiveness. Collaborate with team members to improve the consistency and reliability of internal operations. Communication & Cross-Functional Coordination Serve as a coordination point between Client Leads, team members, and leadership on operational matters. Communicate clearly and professionally regarding deadlines, outstanding actions, and operational priorities. Escalate significant risks promptly, providing relevant context, actions already taken, and recommended next steps. Coordinate meetings, operational reviews, and follow-up actions where required. Promote a culture of proactive communication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. 2–4 years of relevant experience in operations coordination, project coordination, workflow management, or business operations. Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, track commitments, and follow through on outstanding actions. Experience using workflow, project management, or task management systems. Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and escalate issues appropriately. Comfortable working in a remote, deadline-driven, and collaborative environment. Preferred Experience supporting a professional services, accounting, finance, or consulting organization. Familiarity with workflow management tools such as Karbon, Asana, Monday.com, or similar platforms. Exposure to employee onboarding, performance management, or learning and development coordination. Experience preparing operational reports, dashboards, or performance trackers. Familiarity with process documentation and continuous improvement methodologies. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means: Client delivery workflows are monitored consistently, with potential delays identified before deadlines are missed. Outstanding actions are followed through, with clear ownership and visibility. Client Leads receive timely information about workflow bottlenecks, capacity concerns, and operational risks. Leadership receives concise operational reporting that highlights what requires attention and what is being done about it. Onboarding, performance reviews, and employee development activities are coordinated on schedule. Recurring operational problems are identified, addressed, and progressively reduced. Team members experience clearer processes, better coordination, and fewer avoidable surprises. What We Offer Exposure to the operations of a growing strategic accounting and finance advisory firm. Opportunities to work closely with experienced finance professionals and business leadership. Hands-on experience in workflow management, people operations, and operational improvement. Structured learning, mentorship, and professional development. A collaborative, remote-first work environment. Opportunities for career growth into operations management and broader business leadership roles. Who Will Thrive at Fiscal 12? You'll Enjoy This Role If You Naturally notice when something is falling through the cracks. Enjoy bringing structure and clarity to complex situations. Are comfortable following up with colleagues and holding commitments visible. Take initiative rather than waiting for instructions.
